# TheTriFusion (Trifusion Infotech Pvt. Ltd.)

Legal name: Trifusion Infotech Private Limited
Also known as: TheTriFusion, Trifusion Infotech Pvt. Ltd.

Office: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
Service area: Worldwide (remote); India focus including Rajasthan (Bhilwara, Udaipur, Kota, Ajmer) served from Jaipur

We build websites, ecommerce stores, Android/iOS mobile apps, custom software, UI/UX, white-label delivery, and digital marketing.

## EV charging app development

Page: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development
Jaipur-based EV charging software for India and worldwide: driver apps (iOS/Android), charge point management (CPMS), OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1 backends, OCPI 2.2.1 roaming, operator dashboards, billing with GST invoice fields, fleet charging, and white-label apps. The pricing page lists a starting range; this page does not sell a fixed package. No separate IoT service page — charger connectivity is part of this engagement.

- CPMS / EV charging station software: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#cpms
- OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1 backend: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#ocpp-backend
- OCPI 2.2.1 roaming: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#ocpi-roaming
- OCPP vs OCPI: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#ocpp-vs-ocpi
- eMSP and CPO platforms: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#emsp-cpo
- Driver mobile app: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#driver-app
- Operator dashboard: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#operator-dashboard
- Load management and smart charging: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#smart-charging
- OCPP hardware integration: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#hardware-integration
- Billing, tariffs, GST invoices: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#billing-tariffs
- Fleet charging: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#fleet-charging
- White-label EV app: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#white-label
- ISO 15118 / Plug & Charge readiness: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#plug-and-charge
- Analytics: https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#analytics
- India context (Bharat, UPI, GST): https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#india-context
